Drag to pan and pinch or use the mouse wheel to zoom. The Realm map shows the connected forests, stone and berry-rich ground inside every region before you settle it.
Tap empty ground to move the Ember. Its light protects survivors and burns the Blight at night. Drag the bright flame directly when you need precise control.

Open the Job Board and use minus, plus or the sliders to assign roles. Gathering jobs wait for orders: tap Area then paint the trees, stone or berries they may take. Change the brush radius or erase marks at any time.
Move the green ghost to valid ground and confirm it. On desktop you can drag roads and palisades into a whole line; right-click or Escape cancels.
Work continues while the light fades. Bring the Ember home, staff Warriors and inspect the breach arrows before darkness gives the Blight its advantage.
Abilities spend Faith when cast and permanently reduce Faith income while taken up. Tap the Faith readout to see every source and Burden.
Later buildings consume processed goods. Staff their matching jobs and use the resource breakdown to find the exact input that is stopping production.
Each settlement owns its survivors, stockpile and local Blight. Use the Realm to travel or send supplies across adjacent regions; nothing is silently shared.
Several small Blight pockets can threaten a settled map. Uninhabited regions stay dormant. Ward sources locally before their settlements and night pressure mature.
